name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Moving between pages of a long list: a <nav> with Previous, page numbers (first, last, current and its neighbours, gaps as an ellipsis) and Next, from Button and IconButton, in two sizes.
usage: Use Pagination when a list is served in pages and the user needs to jump between them: the audit log, a list of saved queries. Pass page (from 1), pageCount and onPageChange; siblingCount sets how many pages show around the current one; name the landmark with labels.nav when there are several on a page. Results that stream (the data grid) scroll instead; for a few steps of a task use Stepper.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Called with the page the user picked.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one.

props.name: labels
props.description: Accessible names: the landmark (Pagination), the arrows (Previous page, Next page), each page (Page n).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every button, while a page loads.

slots.name: root
slots.description: A navigation landmark named by labels.nav; data-slot="pagination".

slots.name: page
slots.description: A ghost Button per page; the current one has aria-current="page" and color.interactive.selected; data-slot="pagination-page".

states.name: current
states.description: The current page: color.interactive.selected background; around it the neighbours, the first and last pages and aria-hidden gaps in color.fg.subtle.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every button at opacity.disabled; Previous on the first page and Next on the last are disabled too.

accessibility: A <nav> landmark ("Pagination", or labels.nav) holding a list of buttons; the current page has aria-current="page" and its selected background, so the state does not rest on colour.
Every page button is named "Page n"; the arrows are IconButtons named Previous page and Next page and are disabled at the ends.
Tab moves through the buttons; Enter or Space picks a page. Gaps are aria-hidden.
